_comment: The Old World Campaign (Workshop 3081800026), suggested by a player in issue #16; curated 2026-11-24 from its Workshop page so it is filed as a general (non-adult) mod.

mods.name: The Old World Campaign
mods.summary: A new campaign map of the Old World with 1317 settlements and many new factions, all playable.
mods.description:
A new campaign on a map of the Old World: 1317 settlements and many new factions, all of them playable. Where possible, the game's own mechanics are carried over to the new map. Smaller sub-campaigns on the same map (Classic, Darklands) run faster and work in multiplayer; a visual Devastation add-on is optional.

A normal (non-adult) campaign mod; it was suggested by a player (issue #16).
installNotes: Needs MIXER – Mixu's Unlocker (Workshop item 2859968660), as its Workshop page says.
